definitions.explanation: Pork meat that has been finely chopped or passed through a grinder. One of the most commonly used ground meats in Japanese and East Asian cooking.

examples.japanese: {豚|ぶた}ひき{肉|にく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{餃子|ぎょうざ}→餃子：08634_gyouza⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: To make gyoza with ground pork.

examples.japanese: {豚|ぶた}ひき{肉|にく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{二百|にひゃく}⟦グラム→グラム：01354_guramu⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: I'd like 200 grams of ground pork, please.

examples.japanese: ⟦{麻婆豆腐|まーぼーどうふ}→麻婆豆腐：20258_maaboodoufu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{豚|ぶた}ひき{肉|にく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{定番|ていばん}→定番：12265_teiban⟧だ。
examples.english: It's standard to use ground pork for mapo tofu.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{豚|ぶた}→豚：04710_buta⟧ (pork), ひき (ground/minced, from ⟦{挽|ひ}く→挽く：12794_hiku⟧ 'to grind'), and ⟦{肉|にく}→肉：02240_niku⟧ (meat). The most versatile ground meat in Japanese home cooking.

- {豚|ぶた}ひき{肉|にく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{肉|にく}→肉：02240_niku⟧みそ: meat miso (ground pork cooked in miso)

USAGE:
{豚|ぶた}ひき{肉|にく} is the go-to ground meat for Chinese-Japanese dishes like ⟦{麻婆豆腐|まーぼーどうふ}→麻婆豆腐：20258_maaboodoufu⟧, {担々麺|たんたんめん}, ⟦{餃子|ぎょうざ}→餃子：08634_gyouza⟧, and ⟦{春巻|はるま}き→春巻き：28818_harumaki⟧ (spring rolls). It is also essential for {肉味噌|にくみそ}, a versatile condiment used as a topping for ⟦{冷|ひ}やし→冷やす：02403_hiyasu⟧⟦{中華|ちゅうか}→中華：11322_chuuka⟧ and rice.
